title: Saltwater movement in the upper Floridan aquifer beneath Port Royal Sound, South Carolina
citation: Smith, B.S., 1994, Saltwater movement in the upper Floridan aquifer beneath Port Royal Sound, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Supply Paper 2421, map scale 1:247,000.
notes:
Pages 1-35. Hydrology report with a solute-transport model; model input parameters (Table 2, Table 3) and simulated velocities/leakages were not recorded as field values. Figure 4 (p. 14) stratigraphic column is garbled in the text layer; the Santee Limestone name is read from fragments of that figure and flagged inferred. Table 1 (p. 17) per-sample core values (Beaufort County wells 1672-1809) were not recorded individually; the summary statistics given in the text are recorded. Formation descriptions of the Waccamaw, Pamlico and Talbot are attributed in the text to an unpublished 1960 report by Siple. Figure maps (pp. 10, 12, 16, 21, 24, 25) are mostly garbled and skipped.
Pages 36-48. These pages hold model sensitivity tests, hypothetical pumping simulations (simulated values, not recorded), the summary, and the reference list. References relevant to South Carolina and the Floridan aquifer system near Savannah/Hilton Head are recorded; general hydrology/modeling references (Davis 1969, Davis and DeWiest 1966, Domenico and Schwartz 1990, Freeze and Cherry 1979, Frind 1982, Hubbert 1940, Javandel and others 1984, Kohout 1964, Lohman 1972, Voss 1984, Wolff 1982, Cooper 1964) and Georgia-only data reports were skipped. Page 48 is a publisher series list.
